decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the pages-version upload format and even-page-count constraint, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The upload format and page-count parity constraints do not change the existing free-to-start platform requirement or candidate-platform list.
The source change applies to the digital flipbook upload and does not alter the deferred print-ready PDF requirements.
Flipbook upload format and page-count parity do not change the article body font family or treatment.
The source decision does not affect the required shape or size of author photographs.
Requiring a pages-version upload and an even total page count does not replace or modify the requirement that cover references use accurate final page numbers.
The table of contents must still use finalized pagination; the digital upload format and parity rule do not change that requirement.
The source change does not alter the requirement that advertisements render clearly without blurriness.
The pages-version upload and even-page-count constraints do not change the existing policy for correcting white space at article endings.
The source decision does not affect author-name, author-photo, identity-matching, source, or placement requirements.
The flipbook upload and page-parity rules do not modify the publication image-quality enhancement requirement.
The source decision constrains the digital flipbook output rather than changing the issue's content inputs, assembly behavior, or Flat Plan reference.
